out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Designated Use
violations.observation: Observed the handsink in the kitchen being used to store equipment
violations.corrective_action: Handsinks are to be used only for washing hands to encourage proper hand washing and to prevent contamination of cleaned hands. PIC MOVED EQUIPMENT.

violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: egg patty 115F, breakfast sausage 123F
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. PIC AGREED PLACE EGG AND SAUSAGE ON TIME AND DISPOSE OF THEM AT THE END OF BREAKFAST (WITHIN 1 HOUR).

violations.title: When to Wash
violations.observation: A food employee failed to wash his or her hands before engaging in food preparation, after touching bare human body parts, after coughing, sneezing, eating, after handling soiled utensils, or after engaging in any activity that could contaminate the hands. OBSERVED FOOD WORKER PUT ON CLEAN GLOVES AFTER REMOVING SOILED GLOVES WITHOUT WASHING HANDS.
violations.corrective_action: ALL food employees shall wash their hands OFTEN especially after handling trash, using the restroom, handling raw meats, handling soiled equipment and utensils, BEFORE putting on clean gloves, etc. Proper handwashing frequencies will aid in the reduction of foodborne illness. CDI: EHS INSTRUCTED FOOD WORKER TO REMOVE CLEAN GLOVES, WASH HANDS, AND THEN PUT ON CLEAN GLOVES. ENSURE FOOD WORKERS ARE TRAINED ON WHEN TO WASH HANDS.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: 1. OBSERVED 2-DOOR TRUE REFRIGERATOR ON LEFT SIDE IN WAREWASHING AREA TO BE 46F AND HOLDING COOKED SAUSAGE AT 46F AND COOKED EGGS AT 45F. 2. OBSERVED IN LIEBHERR MINIFRIDGE ON BREAKFAST BAR COUNTER TO BE AT 53F AND HOLDING CREAM CHEESE AT 50F AND PEACH YOGURT AT 50F. 3. OBSERVED CARAFE OF WHOLE MILK AT 47F. 4. OBSERVED LIQUID PANCAKE BATTER AT 73F AT WAFFLE BAR.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. CDI: 1. COOKED SAUSAGE AND COOKED EGGS DISPOSED OF AT TIME OF INSPECTION. 2. PIC CONFIRMED FOOD WILL BE USED OR THROWN OUT WITHIN 1HR. 3. MILK WILL BE USED OR DISPOSED OF WITHIN 1HR. 4. LIQUID BATTER WILL BE USED OR DISPOSED OF WITHIN 1HR. ALL FOODS DISPOSED OF DURING INSPECTION. FOOD MUST BE REGULARLY MONITORED FOR PROPER COLD HOLDING OF 41F OR BELOW. CEASE HOLDING FOODS ABOVE THIS TEMPERATURE.

out_items.name: Single-use/single-service articles properly stored and used

violations.title: Single-Service/Use Items, Stored off Floor, Clean Location
violations.observation: OBSERVED MULTIPLE BOXES OF SINGLE SERVICE ITEMS STORED ON THE FLOOR IN DRY STORAGE ROOM.
violations.corrective_action: Cleaned equipment and utensils, laundered linens, and single-service items shall be stored in a clean, dry location where they are not exposed to splash, dust, or other contamination, and at least 6 inches off the floor on NSF approved shelving units or dunnage racks. ALL SINGLE SERVICE ITEMS MUST BE RAISED 6IN ABOVE THE FLOOR. PIC EDUCATED.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: 1. OBSERVED 2-DOOR TRUE REFRIGERATOR ON LEFT SIDE IN WAREWASHING AREA AT 45F. 2. OBSERVED LIEBHERR MINIFRIDGE ON COUNTER AT BREAKFAST BAR AT 53F.
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. BOTH UNITS MAY NOT BE USED TO STORE TCS FOODS UNTIL THEY ARE REPAIRED TO HOLD FOOD AT 41F OR BELOW. ENSURE YOU ARE CHECKING TEMPERATURES OF UNIT AND FOOD WITHIN IT.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: OBSERVED GAPS AROUND CEILING TILES IN DRY STORAGE ROOM.
violations.corrective_action: Repair the physical facilities. Poor repair and maintenance compromises the functionality of the physical facilities. SEAL THE GAPS AROUND CEILING TILES IN DRY STORAGE AREA.

out_items.name: Adequate ventilation and lighting, designated areas used

violations.title: Designated Storage for Clothing, Possessions
violations.observation: Observed employee clothing and other possessions stored in areas that may contaminate food, food-contact surfaces of equipment, single-service items, or single- use items. OSBERVED PURSES, CLOTHING, WALLETS, AND OTHER PERSONAL ITEMS SCATTERED ON THE RACKS WITH SINGLE SERVICE ITEMS IN THE DRY STORAGE AREA.
violations.corrective_action: Instruct employees to use the designated lockers and clothes hooks to prevent contamination of food, food equipment and utensils, and preparation surfaces. DESIGNATE AN AREA FOR PERSONAL POSSESSIONS SO THEY DO NOT CONTAMINATE FOOD CONTACT SURFACES OR SINGLE SERVICE ITEMS. COMFORT INN (Inspection Date: 06/03/2025) Page 2 of 3
